Card Q&A.a: No, you can't activate it. The Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted before this card's inherited effect activates, therefore it can't be activated.
Card Q&A.q: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards battled an opponent's Digimon, and both Digimon lost the battle and were deleted. Can I activate this card's inherited effect at such times?

Card Q&A.a: It triggers once. If both Digimon lose a battle, both are deleted at the same time.
